landing.body: You've tried it alone before and it fizzled out after a month. This time you get a plan, a meal plan — and most importantly, someone who checks in every week and adjusts it based on your results.
landing.ctaNote: First we figure out what actually makes sense for you.
landing.stepBody: I'm behind the app and the plan. I know where you are, and I won't let you give up.

glossary.systolic: Systolic (upper) pressure — the pressure in your arteries when your heart beats. Normal is roughly 90–120.
glossary.diastolic: Diastolic (lower) pressure — the pressure in your arteries between heartbeats. Normal is roughly 60–80.
glossary.pulse: Pulse — how many times your heart beats per minute. A normal resting pulse is roughly 60–100.
glossary.weight: For accurate comparisons, weigh yourself in the morning on an empty stomach, at the same time each day.
glossary.steps: Daily step count — a rough indicator of your overall daily activity.
glossary.water: Your daily goal is calculated from your latest logged weight, whether you have a workout scheduled today (and how intense it is), and the current weather where you are (if you allow location access).

comments.no_data: Not enough entries yet to see a trend. Try logging your weight regularly.
comments.down_wanted: You're down {{amount}} kg over the last month — great progress toward your goal!

comments.up_unwanted: You're up {{amount}} kg over the last month. If that wasn't the plan, it's worth talking to your trainer about your nutrition.
comments.stable: Your weight has been stable over the last month — great for maintaining.

comments.above_target: You're averaging {{amount}} steps a day over the last month — great activity level!
comments.below_target: You're averaging {{amount}} steps a day. Try adding a short extra walk to get closer to 8,000.
